content: The appeal of $\alpha $-entmax for attention rests on the following properties. For $\alpha =1$ (i.e., when $\mathsf {H}^{\textsc {T}}_\alpha $ becomes the Shannon entropy), it exactly recovers the softmax mapping (We provide a short derivation in Appendix SECREF89.). For all $\alpha >1$ it permits sparse solutions, in stark contrast to softmax. In particular, for $\alpha =2$, it recovers the sparsemax mapping BIBREF19, which is piecewise linear. In-between, as $\alpha $ increases, the mapping continuously gets sparser as its curvature changes.
